headline: Harvest season pushes down horticultural prices, causing 0.35 percent deflation in NTB
summary: The Central Statistics Agency said harvest season pushed down horticultural commodity prices. This caused monthly deflation of 0.35 percent.
why: Inflation data from Indonesia's statistics agency guides the central bank's policy decisions. Food prices make up a large share of household spending in the country.
